_comment: Sample discovery profile. Copy, complete, and point TRACER_PROFILE_PATH at the copy.
The ProfileVersion below contains 'PENDING' on purpose: TerminalSelectorReadiness treats
PENDING / UNSET / TBD / PLACEHOLDER / SESSION1 / DISCOVERY / EXAMPLE / CHANGEME as placeholder
markers, so this file as shipped can never enable live execution. Replace it with a real
version string only once the control selectors below carry values from a genuine capture.
SELECTOR MODEL — Win32, not UI Automation. IdealPOS (IPS.exe) is VB6/ThunderRT6. A Session-1
capture on 2026-09-04 walked 57 nodes and found ZERO non-empty AutomationIds: UI Automation
returns only window chrome, and the Win32 EnumChildWindows fallback is the only mechanism that
yields content. Controls are therefore addressed by class name, VB6 control id (GetDlgCtrlID),
caption, and ancestor class path. Never record an HWND here — handles are re-issued on every
form load, so identity is resolved at runtime, never persisted.
A selector needs at least one NON-POSITIONAL discriminator (ClassName, ControlId, TextEquals or
TextContains). Ordinal and ClassPath may refine a selector but never constitute one, because
they follow a layout change silently. A selector that matches zero or more than one control
fails closed — it is never narrowed by taking the first match.
_comment_window: Which top-level window is the sale screen. A bare title hint is NOT sufficient: the back-office
MDI frame's title contains 'Idealpos' and the sale window's title ('POS Screen') does not, so a
hint alone selects exactly the wrong window. TitleEquals outranks every other signal; excludes
are absolute; a tie at the top score fails closed as ambiguous rather than guessing.
_comment_selectors: PENDING a correctly-bound POS Screen capture. Each null below is why readiness refuses.
_comment_verification: TableAssignmentConfirmationControl is REQUIRED. The action layer proves a table assignment by
re-reading this control after the action and requiring its text to carry the requested table
code. Without it there is no way to earn success, so readiness refuses — an action that can act
but cannot verify must never be enabled.
